annotations.title: Approve, redo or drop variants of one piece

description:
[PUBLISHES to social accounts · `publish` scope] Decides several variants of a group from list_approval_groups at once, each as decide_approval would: `members` "all" (open variants), an array of approvalIds, or {axis: value} (e.g. {"audio":"voice"}). "approve" marks them approved (a manual approval is NOT posted; a workflow approval resumes its run, which may publish — GOES LIVE); "redo" rejects with the Redo reason; "drop" rejects (`note` = reason). Already-decided variants are skipped. Needs the explicit `approve` scope (admin does not include it). Agency plan. Confirm the count with the user first.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/approval-groups/{groupId}/decide.)

members.description: "all" (default): every open variant. An array: those approval ids. An object: the variants whose labels match every axis value, e.g. {"audio":"voice"}.

note.description: On drop/redo: the reason. Optional unless the org requires one.
